title: Build an IT helpdesk page in Lovable
description: Paste a prompt into Lovable to get a private page that answers common IT questions from your Glean docs.

questions.prompt: What is your work email? It is used once to discover your Glean tenant.
What IT topic do you know your docs cover?

prerequisites: A Glean Client API token with the CHAT scope. Create it in Admin Console → API access → Client API tokens, and keep it as a Lovable backend secret. Every request uses that token owner's access
A private Lovable project. Multi-user deployments require authenticated per-user Glean OAuth

demoQueries.query: Where do I reset my SSO password?
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: A cited answer from your own IT docs, with a real title and URL.

demoQueries.query: How do I request a new laptop?
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: A cited answer from your own IT docs, with a real title and URL.

codeAssets.description: The exact Lovable prompt + secrets checklist

steps.title: Copy your instance name
steps.description: Copy the instance name from the lookup on this page, or from `https://app.glean.com/admin/about-glean`. For `https://acme-be.glean.com` that value is `acme`, not the full URL and not `app.glean.com`. Cookbook plugin users can run `resolve-backend.mjs` with the work email and use the `instance` field.

steps.title: Copy the prompt into a private Lovable project
steps.description: Click `Copy Lovable prompt`. Replace `<your-glean-instance>` with your instance name. Paste the result into a new private project at `https://lovable.dev`. Cookbook plugin users: the same text is in `lovable-prompt.md` next to this skill.

steps.title: Add secrets when Lovable asks
steps.description: When Lovable asks, add `GLEAN_API_TOKEN` and `GLEAN_INSTANCE` as backend secrets, never in the chat. This token is one person's Glean access. Keep the project private.

steps.title: Ask the two IT questions
steps.description: Ask "Where do I reset my SSO password?" and "How do I request a new laptop?" Each answer should cite a real doc from your own instance.

aiPrompt: I'm using Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex, not Lovable. Do not open Lovable. Ask for my work email if needed, run `node <cookbook-plugin-root>/scripts/resolve-backend.mjs "<work-email>"`, and use the instance field from that JSON as GLEAN_INSTANCE. Open lovable-prompt.md next to this skill. Replace <your-glean-instance> with that name and set the first suggested question to a natural question about the IT topic they named. Show me the filled prompt so I can paste it into a new private Lovable project. Remind me GLEAN_API_TOKEN and GLEAN_INSTANCE go in Lovable backend secrets, never in the prompt. Then walk the remaining steps.
llmContext: Keep this single-user prototype private. Its shared backend token is one service identity, so every request has the token owner's access. Multi-user deployment requires app authentication and per-user Glean OAuth. Keep the token in Lovable's server-side secret store, call Client Chat from a backend function, and read CONTENT text and fragment.citation.sourceDocument citations. GLEAN_INSTANCE is Instance name from https://app.glean.com/admin/about-glean, for example acme.

content.problem:
Half the helpdesk tickets are "how do I reset my SSO password" and "how do I get a new laptop." The IT docs already answer both.

This recipe builds a private Lovable page that answers those questions from your Glean content before a ticket gets filed.
takeItFurther: Scope the `CHAT` token even further if your Glean plan supports per-collection tokens, so this tool can only ever answer from IT content.
Compare this to [`no-code-pto-lookup-replit`](/cookbook/no-code-pto-lookup-replit). Same Chat API call, same constraint that the browser never holds the token, different no-code tool and persona.
Once your team outgrows the no-code version, [`company-answers`](/cookbook/company-answers) shows the same pattern as a hand-written, version-controlled app.
